title: Laban
lead: Rebekah's brother in Haran, father of Leah and Rachel, who gave Rebekah to Isaac and later outwitted and was outwitted by Jacob. He makes a border covenant with Jacob at Galeed and returns home (Genesis 24; 29–31). Later Jewish tradition remembered him as the deceiver par excellence (compare Deuteronomy 26:5 in the Passover Haggadah).
